# DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Abliterated or Uncensored — 7API

> DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 abliterated or uncensored models: one primary DeepSeek prompt plus a 34-file prompt collection, a model guide, evaluation method and API access through 7API. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token.

## Key facts

- Primary keyword: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 abliterated or uncensored.
- Covers: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 abliterated model, uncensored model, jailbreak prompts and API.
- The primary prompt is `deepseek-4-1.md`; the other 34 prompt/config files are in `collection/`. The wider multi-model collection is also in the AI Jailbreaks repository.
- API: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible; works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and Codex CLI.
- Billing: pay per token, no subscription; crypto top-ups.
- Model IDs and variant availability are listed in the 7API dashboard.
- Abliteration reduces refusals; it does not guarantee refusal-free output.
- `1017` is part of the build/variant label; confirm the current model ID before deploying.
